name: gate-all-dp
summary: Standby gate v2: with automatic input, standby is refused while a source is active on any DP-class connector (DP or USB-C), not only the current one; fixed input: the selected one; no answer from the front-end: refused. Each connector is asked by its own id (replaces gate-raw-id)
status: hardware-tested 2026-10-08: automatic input, both outputs off -> deep standby, no wake for minutes; after a key wake the dock held the DP link (DP: source active) -> link-held standby, deep standby as soon as the dock released the link

edits.asm: gate2 (linker padding 0x2038AC): automatic input -> ask ports 0 and 1, else the current port
gq (linker padding 0x203B78): 0x60/0xB for one DP-class connector by front-end id
